一句话作用: Capture and automate macOS UI with the Peekaboo CLI.
关键输入: - App/window: --app, --pid, --window-title, --window-id, --window-index - Snapshot: --snapshot (ID from see) - Element/coords: --on/--id, --coords x,y
关键输出: 过程辅助，无固定交付物
解决具体问题: 当需要Notes - Requires Screen Recording + Accessibility permissions. - Use peekaboo see --annotate to identify targets before clicking.时，用它完成对应判断、生成或操作流程。
